human_feedback_verbatim:
The Apparition trade can be powerful, but once it reduces maximum HP substantially, avoid stacking another sacrifice unless the remaining HP and healing route are clearly safe. In this run, the better follow-up would have been to refuse the next max-HP trade and preserve the smaller health buffer for Act 2 elites and the boss.
When the Automaton was attacking and the player had 17-33 HP, evaluate damage and block first instead of repeatedly spending energy on Second Wind or setup. Preserve enough energy for the strongest available attack or defensive line, especially when the enemy's block is already low or an orb can be finished.
37/48 hp should be sufficient to survive combat, do not need to rest if hp % is high.
taking random rare card is better than 100 gold for neow's blessing
manage hp better during combat
